selection_policy.age: C008 baseline age, inclusive 20-79; no topcoding is declared in the supplied lab dictionary. No lab-date age is inferred.
selection_policy.anthropometry: Require weight 30-200 kg and height 120-210 cm per dictionary; remove 999 error and unavailable values. No BMI magnitude trimming beyond these documented source validity limits.
selection_policy.pregnancy: Exclude only P005==1 at baseline. Unknown and inapplicable/missing status remain. Baseline status cannot establish pregnancy status at the 2014-2015 blood collection.
selection_policy.target: Select only available numeric finite Z034. No target magnitude limits, outlier trimming, clinical threshold selection, diagnostic selection or proxy selection.
selection_policy.missingness: Complete-case eligibility on age, sex, valid measured anthropometry, positive finite lab weight and target availability; no imputation or reweighting for these additional restrictions.

timing.anthropometry: Final measured values in laboratory release, interpreted as baseline survey anthropometry; exact participant measurement dates are not supplied.
timing.implication: Age and pregnancy refer to the baseline interview. The covariate-outcome relationship spans a variable lag; this is not asserted to be contemporaneous.

design.estimand: Lab-complete participant distribution under supplied peso_lab, with unweighted sensitivity. Additional complete-case restrictions are not automatically nationally representative.
design.permitted_later_evaluation: Provided-weight point estimates and unweighted sensitivity only. No complex-survey standard errors or confidence intervals without a valid recovered design.
design.weight_interpretation: Official lab page describes post-stratification using age, education, race/color and macroregion. Calibration adequacy for national generalization remains unresolved.

information_boundary.builder_visible: Only visible/ and approved external evidence artifacts. Download/preparation scripts are custodian-only because they access raw targets.
information_boundary.prohibited: custodian/, raw workbook, reference values, ID mapping, lab weights, target summaries, Z035 and any HbA1c-derived diagnosis/proxy; all other source row-level columns are omitted.
information_boundary.enforcement: Procedural custody in a shared filesystem; no OS sandbox or cryptographic confidentiality is claimed. Hashes provide integrity, not access control.
information_boundary.freshness: New project case only. No claim that the model has never encountered these public data in pretraining.
